request.description:
Retrieve driver location history using the same endpoint for both live and replay use cases.

Default behavior:
- Returns active session route points.
- If no active session exists, returns the latest session route points.

Optional filters:
- assignment_id: get trip-specific route points (works after trip end)
- session_id: get route points for a specific session
- from/to: recorded_at time window
- limit: max points (1-10000)

Each route point includes assignment_id so maps can distinguish trip-linked vs general movement.
